evidence.text: A false 叚 person 亻; 叚 also provides the pronunciation
Phonosemantic compound. 亻 represents the meaning and 叚 represents the sound.
非眞也。从人叚聲。一曰至也。《虞書》曰：“假于上下。”

Phono-semantic compound (形聲 /形声, OC *kraːʔ, *kraːs): semantic 亻 (“person”) + phonetic 叚 (OC *kraːʔ).
; “to borrow; false”
: Cognate with Tibetan ཀར་སྐྱིན (kar skyin, “loan; thing borrowed”). An allofam is probably 雇 (OC *kʷaːs, *ɡʷaːʔ, “to hire”) (Schuessler, 2007).
: Compare also perhaps Burmese ကြွေး (krwe:, “debt”) (STEDT).
